get_comm_comp_overlap: compute the overlap percentage between communication and computation kernels for each rank in a trace
visualize_comm_comp_overlap: generate a bar chart showing computation-communication overlap percentage per rank using plotly
analyze_gpu_kernel_overlap: analyze GPU trace data to find time intervals where communication and computation kernels overlap

calculate_overlap_ratio: calculate the ratio of overlapping time to total communication kernel time across all ranks
